subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes provides annual income support to farmers directly into their bank accounts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM-KISAN**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **PM-KISAN** stands for **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi**, a flagship scheme of the Indian government.
 
• Under this scheme, the government provides **income support of Rs. 6,000 per year** to all eligible small and marginal farmers.
 
• The amount is directly transferred into the **bank accounts of beneficiaries** in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 each.
 
• It was launched on **24th February 2019** by PM Narendra Modi in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The scheme aims to ensure **financial stability and reduce the economic distress** faced by farmers, particularly those owning cultivable land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eligibility for PM-KISAN:**

 
 
• All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names are eligible.
 
• However, institutional landholders, taxpayers, and professionals like doctors, engineers, and government employees are excluded.
 
 
 
• **Funding and Implementation:**
 
 
• The scheme is **fully funded by the central government** and is implemented across India, including Union Territories.
 
• State governments are responsible for identifying and verifying beneficiaries.
 
 
 
• **Benefits:**
 
 
• Direct cash transfer to farmers helps in reducing dependency on informal credit and strengthens rural financial infrastructure.
 
• The scheme supports improved agricultural productivity and income stability.
 
 
 
• **Technology Integration:**
 
 
• The scheme utilizes technology and the Aadhaar database for beneficiary identification and fund transfer.
 
• This ensures **transparency and minimizes duplication** in disbursal.
